content:
I got the impression from an earlier discussion that it's possible to use loogle locally without hitting the internet, presumably searching through a local installation of mathlib.

I've found a loogle feature in the vscode plugin, but it works by making requests to the internet. Is there a way to run it locally, and if so, how?

Yes there is; the instructions are in the repository: https://github.com/nomeata/loogle

Also take a look at my own tool that I just wrote called rlean-search: https://createyourpersonalaccount.github.io/rlean-search/

My tool is very simple to use & fast but I haven't written the integration for vscode yet.
